name: marblo-functions
description: Marblo Cloud Functions (TossPayments KR + Paddle global integration)

scripts.backfill:marketing-contacts:build: tsc src/marketingContacts.ts src/waitlistMarketingBackfill.ts src/index.ts scripts/backfill-marketing-contacts.ts --outDir .script-out/marketing-backfill --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck
scripts.announce:release:build: tsc src/marketingContacts.ts src/releaseAnnouncement.ts scripts/send-release-announcement.ts --outDir .script-out/release --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck
scripts.test:reject: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/founderReject.test.mjs'
scripts.test:followup: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/founderFollowup.test.mjs'
scripts.test:survey-offer: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/founderSurveyOffer.test.mjs'
scripts.test:consent-sync: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project marblo-test 'node tests/marketingConsentSync.test.mjs'
scripts.test:marketing: tsc src/marketingContacts.ts src/marketingContacts.test.ts src/waitlistMarketingBackfill.ts src/waitlistMarketingBackfill.test.ts --outDir .test-out/marketing --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck && node --test .test-out/marketing/marketingContacts.test.js .test-out/marketing/waitlistMarketingBackfill.test.js
scripts.test:admin-analytics: tsc src/adminAnalytics.ts src/adminAnalytics.test.ts --outDir .test-out/admin --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck && node --test .test-out/admin/adminAnalytics.test.js
scripts.test:project-audit: tsc src/projectAudit.ts src/projectAudit.test.ts --outDir .test-out/project-audit --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck && node --test .test-out/project-audit/projectAudit.test.js
scripts.test:cost-logs-limit: tsc src/costLogsLimit.ts src/costLogsLimit.test.ts --outDir .test-out/cost-logs --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict && node --test .test-out/cost-logs/costLogsLimit.test.js
scripts.test:release-announcement: tsc src/releaseAnnouncement.ts src/releaseAnnouncement.test.ts --outDir .test-out/release --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict && node --test .test-out/release/releaseAnnouncement.test.js
scripts.test:release-update-announcement: tsc src/releaseUpdateAnnouncement.ts src/releaseUpdateAnnouncement.test.ts --outDir .test-out/release-update --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --strict && node --test .test-out/release-update/releaseUpdateAnnouncement.test.js
